dedupe_keys.name: enviroportal sk landslide and ground movement hazard datasets

description: enviroportal.sk: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by enviroportal.sk. Coverage: the area served by enviroportal.sk. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Svahové deformácie [Atlas krajiny Slovenskej republiky]; Náchylnosť územia na zosúvanie [Atlas krajiny Slovenskej republiky]; Územie ohrozované snehovými lavínami [Atlas krajiny Slovenskej republi. Formats seen: WMS, WFS, WCS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
